## YT-DLP Command Builder 1.0.8

- Added a separate daily Notes Log to the information/history window. While the app is open, it checks notes every ten minutes and keeps at most one updated snapshot per local date. Unchanged notes do not create repeat writes.
- Added the Instagram-link count to the Link Notes header and a confirmed clear-notes button. Clearing notes preserves both command history and daily note records.
- Standalone Instagram usernames now resolve to `https://www.instagram.com/stories/<username>` in Link Notes and the main link field. Format annotations such as `V1s` stay intact.
- Updated to Android version 1.0.8 (version code 9).

Android 10 or newer. This app only generates commands. It does not download or query Instagram content. Signed with the existing release identity.
